findings.body: The CI job runs `pnpm build`, which the supplied close-run output shows builds the web and API projects. It does not build a container image. The updated Compose service specifies a prebuilt Postgres image and has no build step. Add and pass a check that builds the required image so the image-build acceptance criterion is verified.
